subject: Stakeholder mapping & procurement next steps — FinovateBank
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@finovatebank.com>, Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@finovatebank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up + stakeholder mapping (post-demo)

Hi Sanjay / Olivia — thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our demo: 

What we covered:
- Demo of Redwood inference latency and cost controls for batch/real-time flows
- Prefix/KV caching and routing options for compliance/regional controls
- Typical deployment patterns for regulated banks (Private/VPC + KMS)

Decision criteria you mentioned:
- Security/compliance evidence (SOC 2 type II, encryption at rest, audit logs)
- Procurement timeline and SOW approval path
- Economic buyer alignment and total cost of ownership (1st year run rate)

Ask / next steps:
1) Can you share a short stakeholder map (names + decision role) for the project — particularly procurement, security, and the economic buyer?
2) Any procurement-specific docs/clauses we should prepare now (data residency, SLAs, indemnity)?
3) Would you like a short technical packet (SOC2 artifacts + architecture diagram) to share with your security team?

I attached the demo deck and a draft SOW template to help with internal conversations. If it helps, I can run a short 30-minute call with your security/contact owner next week to walk through the compliance artifacts.

Proposed times: Tue/Wed next week 10–12 PT. Let me know what works.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Attachment: Redwood_Demo_Deck.pdf (20 slides)
Attachment: Draft_SOW_Template.docx (stub)

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@finovatebank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@finovatebank.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Follow-up + stakeholder mapping (post-demo)

Thanks Marissa — great demo. A few quick notes from our side and answers to your asks: 

Stakeholders (high level):
- Economic buyer: Priya Rao (Head of Platforms) — will own budget sign-off
- Procurement lead: Marcus Healy (Procurement Manager) — contract and SOW lead
- Security reviewer: Olivia Grant (that's me on the security side for initial review)
- Product champion: Sanjay Patel (me) — moving this internally

Procurement timeline: ~6–8 weeks once we have an SOW and security artifacts. Procurement will want a standard Master Services Agreement + SOW; they typically run redlines with legal in week 2–3.

Security asks: 
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest period)
- Encryption at rest/in transit details and KMS options
- Audit log retention and export capabilities

Cost question: can you give a high-level 12-month TCO range (dev + prod) for a ~100k requests/month ingestion profile? Even a ballpark helps our finance folks.

I'll pull Priya and Marcus into the thread once we have the SOW + SOC2 doc. We can do Tue 10:30 PT next week for a security touchpoint.

—Sanjay
Sanjay Patel
Senior PM, FinovateBank
sanjay.patel@finovatebank.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@finovatebank.com>, Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@finovatebank.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Follow-up + stakeholder mapping — enablement for champion (internal)

Team — forwarding the FinovateBank thread. Quick ask to enable our champion (Sanjay) and to make sure we can hit the procurement timeline. High level asks from FinovateBank: SOC2, SOW, and a 12-month TCO ballpark for ~100k requests/month. 

What I need from each of you: 
- Rishi (Security): can you pull the latest SOC2 Type II pack + a 1-page runbook that outlines encryption/KMS options and log retention? Sanjay asked for export capabilities and retention windows. If we can have a short packet by Mon EOD that would be ideal.
- Neha (SE): can you prepare a one-page architecture diagram (Private/VPC option + routing) and a short ROI calc for 100k req/mo (tokens per request estimate: ~400 tokens/request)? Put the TCO as a 12-month range (low/expected/high).
- Markus (Legal): procurement wants an SOW and expects redlines in week 2–3. Can you review the attached Draft_SOW_Template.docx and flag any sticky clauses we should pre-emptively adjust (data residency, indemnity, SLA exceptions)? Also estimate how long legal review would realistically take once Marcus Healy engages.

Talk tracks for the champion: 
- Emphasize predictable unit economics: batching + KV caching will reduce per-token compute by ~30–45% for your workload patterns.
- Risk mitigation: private deployment options, KMS integration, and audit logs to satisfy regulatory auditors.
- Enablement offer: I'm proposing a short security walkthrough + one-week POC credit to validate performance (will need approval for credits).

I will coordinate the Tue 10:30 PT time with Sanjay/Olivia and will loop Priya / Marcus (procurement) once we have the packet.

Thanks —
Marissa
Attachment: Redwood_Demo_Deck.pdf
Attachment: Draft_SOW_Template.docx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@finovatebank.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Follow-up + stakeholder mapping — enablement for champion (internal)

On it. I'll gather the SOC2 artifacts and assemble a 1-page security runbook that covers: scope of SOC2, encryption (AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit), KMS options (BYOK + cloud KMS), audit log capture and retention options (30/90/365 days), and export procedures.

Neha — once I have the runbook I'll sync on any infra assumptions that affect the ROI calc (cache hit rates, batching latency targets).

Markus — happy to flag any security-related contract asks for you to consider (incident response SLAs, data processing terms).

I'll target sending the packet by Mon 07/31 EOD PT.

Thanks,
Rishi
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
